units.frame: aircraft body metres: +x right,+y up,+z nose

conventions.configuration: Exact production host arguments before native ABI clamping; zero envelope AoA uses native automatic limit, not missing physical stall data.
conventions.gunDirection: Production fixed400m body-frame convergence; muzzle ports alternate by max(1,fired)-1 modulo port count. Dispersion/recoil/aircraft world transform are runtime behavior.
conventions.ammo: Each guns entry is one logical feed; shared rotary muzzle ports do not multiply ammo. Belt order and repeated shell IDs are preserved.
conventions.fuel: sourceTuple=[internalCapacityKg,dryKgPerNewtonSecond,afterburningKgPerNewtonSecond?,pistonFullPowerKgPerSecond?]. eng=max(.05,throttle||0). Piston=tuple[3]*min(1.15,max(.08,eng)). Jet dry=tuple[1]*airframe[12]; eng>1.005 with tuple[2] gives dry+tuple[2]*airframe[12]*(1+airframe[13])*min(1,(eng-1)/.12), else dry*min(1,eng). Samples are actual fuelFlow results. stepAirFuel stops for engineOff/crash/broken/dead engine/prop or ground throttle<.06; live external tanks burn first. capacityKg is internal only; add actual live external remainder.
conventions.stores: layoutStores evaluated against actual imported model specifications and original store socket metadata. storeWarhead and tntEquivalentKg execute unchanged to produce full projectile definitions; projectile_id links each applicable store and rocket_projectile_id links pods. Custom user choices are not imported; slots expose available options. Guided, cluster and electronics choices are open by default; native runtime owns acquisition, release, projectiles and damage. This data export alone is not an end-to-end test receipt.
conventions.scope: Data export only, not native frontline flight integration or verified historical variant/store/sensor capability. Existing aircraft IDs and source variant mismatches are preserved.
